title: Gate record
description: One JSON file per gate outcome under gate-records/. Audit finding N5 (2026-07-29): this schema previously described a single, richer per-gate-decision shape (gate_id/rd/gate_type/verdict/reviewer/ts) that nothing in the plugin ever wrote. Reconciled to describe the three shapes actually produced in production, confirmed against this project's own gate-records/*.json: (1) phase-level records (gate-records/PB<n>-*.json, written by /cz:scope through /cz:risk), (2) RD-level Definition-of-Ready records (gate-records/RD-*-dor.json, written by /cz:dor), and (3) RD-level review-gate records (gate-records/RD-*-gate.json, written by /cz:gate step 7). hooks/guard-pipeline-order.sh (M4's fix) mechanically checks shapes (1) and (2) via their flat `status:"passed"` field; nothing currently validates any gate-records/*.json file against this schema file mechanically (confirmed by grep — only this file's own $id and templates/gate-record-template.json's comment reference it), so widening this schema carries no runtime risk.

phaseGateRecord.title: Phase-level gate record (gate-records/PB<n>-<name>.json)
phaseGateRecord.description: Written by the pipeline-phase commands (/cz:scope through /cz:risk) once a phase's gate closes. Example: gate-records/PB0-scope.json.

step.description: Pipeline phase number (0 = scope, 1 = spec, ... 6 = risk).

artifact.description: The single deliverable this gate covers, e.g. "SCOPE-AIBOOTCAMP.md".

artifacts.description: Used instead of `artifact` when a phase produces more than one deliverable (e.g. PB6-risk.json covers both RISK-*.md and DELEGATION-MAP-*.md).

approver.description: "auto" (human_gates.<phase> is false) or a human identifier/note, e.g. "human (via chat)".

notes.description: Free-text rationale for the auto/human decision. Optional; present on several real records (e.g. PB5-estimate.json, PB6-risk.json).

rdDorRecord.title: RD-level Definition-of-Ready record (gate-records/RD-<id>-dor.json)
rdDorRecord.description: Written by /cz:dor once an RD's Definition of Ready check passes. Flat shape, same family as phaseGateRecord but keyed by rd_id instead of step/project.

rdReviewGateRecord.title: RD-level review-gate record (gate-records/RD-<id>-gate.json)
rdReviewGateRecord.description: Written by /cz:gate step 7 — the fixed-order AI-review -> [security-review] -> human-approval outcome for one RD's build cycle. Richer, nested shape; distinct from the flat phase/DOR records above.

cycle.description: Which red-green-review cycle this gate record is for; increments each time a rejected RD loops back through /cz:build.

order_enforced.description: True once the three-timestamp chronological-non-decreasing check (ai_review -> security_review -> gate_decision) described in /cz:gate step 7 has been satisfied.

devbook_precondition.description: Optional pre-check recording that the DEVBOOK's green run was byte-identical to its red run before review began.

hazard_leash_lookup.description: Optional record of the module/hazard/leash values used to decide whether security review was required (per DELEGATION-MAP-<proj>.md).

security_review.description: Either the bare string "not_required" (security review not triggered — see /cz:gate step 5), or an object once a security review actually ran.

approver.description: "auto" (human_gates.gate is false) or a human identifier.

estimate_variance.description: Only present when gate_decision.decision is "approved" — written by hooks/compute-estimate-variance.sh at /cz:gate step 8, before the lock is released. Compares planner's pre-build estimate.expected_h/.pessimistic (rd/<id>.md) against this RD's actual build time, derived purely from telemetry/events.jsonl timestamps already recorded for this rd id — no new capture mechanism, no token figures (Claude Code hooks have no real per-RD token/cost source; see emit-telemetry.sh's cost_usd comment). This is the audit point a later /cz:audit run or agentops WEEKLY rollup reads to judge whether planner's estimates run systematically high or low.

actual_h.description: Raw wall-clock span (first-to-last telemetry timestamp for this rd), including any idle/blocked time. Kept for throughput reporting; NOT what variance_pct is computed against.

active_h.description: actual_h with idle/blocked gaps longer than idle_gap_threshold_s excluded (e.g. queued behind max_in_flight, waiting on a human gate, overnight). This is the work-effort figure variance_pct and within_pessimistic_bound are computed against, since the RD estimate is a work-effort guess, not a wall-clock promise.

idle_h.description: actual_h - active_h. Time excluded as idle/blocked, not attributed to work on this RD.

idle_gap_threshold_s.description: Gap length (seconds) above which a span between two consecutive telemetry events for this RD is treated as idle rather than active. Defaults to guard-claim-lock.sh's LOCK_TTL_S (1800) — the same threshold past which the plugin already considers a claim no longer actively held. Overridable per run via CZ_IDLE_GAP_THRESHOLD_S.

variance_pct.description: (active_h - estimated_h) / estimated_h * 100. Positive means the RD took more active work time than planner expected.

note.description: Present instead of numeric fields when a value genuinely could not be computed (no estimate on record, no telemetry found) — an honest null, not a silently skipped field.
